ownership.sourceReusePolicy: Guides link to runnable example source and never maintain a copied implementation snippet.
ownership.internalLinkPolicy: Repository documentation uses relative links; canonical API and site narrative links use the declared owners.

executionLabels.label: Fixture
executionLabels.description: Deterministic committed data; no live-service claim.

executionLabels.label: Public live
executionLabels.description: Reads a public standards endpoint without a Honua account.

executionLabels.label: Demo live
executionLabels.description: Can read the deployed demo.honua.io service when configured and reports availability and freshness.

executionLabels.label: Authenticated
executionLabels.description: Requires caller-supplied credentials; documentation never embeds a secret.

executionLabels.label: Degraded
executionLabels.description: A reduced capability remains visible with a structured reason and recovery path.

executionLabels.label: Experimental
executionLabels.description: Uses a pre-1.0 surface that may change in a minor release.

paths.title: Start with a public map
paths.outcome: Open a public GeoServices endpoint and render useful data without an account.

paths.title: Connect and inspect sources
paths.outcome: Discover services, layers, schemas, and capability gaps before choosing a workflow.
paths.degradationReason: The current shell still uses the 0.1.x app-workspace compatibility shim; #399 owns its supported-import migration.

paths.title: Query from Node or browser code
paths.outcome: Issue bounded queries, inspect typed results, and keep capability failures explicit.
paths.degradationReason: The live endpoint may omit requested query capabilities; the sample keeps the typed capability error visible.

paths.title: Connect, explain, and map query results
paths.outcome: Connect, discover, explain, query, and mount one source with linked MapLibre views and visible runtime evidence.

paths.title: Analyze linked spatial views
paths.outcome: Keep map, table, chart, and spatial aggregation state aligned with visible fallback evidence.
paths.degradationReason: The current shell still uses the 0.1.x app-workspace compatibility shim; #399 owns its supported-import migration.

paths.title: Plan, analyze, and edit with recovery
paths.outcome: Search a parcel, run bounded geometry analysis, and apply metadata-backed edits and attachments without hiding unsupported mutations.
paths.degradationReason: Metadata or capability discovery failure disables analysis, export, and mutation; deterministic fixture output is never presented as live or regulatory evidence.

paths.title: Operate through realtime and offline transitions
paths.outcome: Reconcile snapshots and deltas while showing reconnect, staleness, and deterministic fixture fallback.
paths.degradationReason: The production offline persistence path is not complete; reconnect and stale-state behavior remains explicit while fixture replay stays deterministic.

paths.title: Add terrain and 3D context
paths.outcome: Progress from stable 2D map primitives to an explicitly experimental 2.5D/3D experience.
paths.degradationReason: The runnable 2.5D shell still reaches the scene-workspace compatibility surface; stable map/runtime imports are the taught foundation until #399 migrates it.

paths.title: Migrate an ArcGIS application
paths.outcome: Scan and transform one file at a time with explicit compatibility evidence and manual gaps.
paths.degradationReason: Unsupported ArcGIS modules remain manual migration work and are reported rather than removed silently.

paths.title: Automate safely with agent tools
paths.outcome: Expose bounded map actions with capability explanations while keeping writes behind host approval.
paths.degradationReason: The current assistant shell still uses the app-workspace compatibility surface, and write execution stays disabled without explicit host approval.
